source: Paired InstaBox, Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME Shell, 800x520. This test reuses an authenticated command recording from an earlier live cloud session.
environment: Win64 CPython 3.13.17, native VirGL/WGL in Wine 10, private network namespace, separate X11 window reader
procedure: Replay the original command recording, checking every local scanout against the corresponding cloud hash.
Close and remove the command file. Drop the last callback's pixel buffer and paint the client area black. Check that the independent window reader sees black.
Create a fresh native renderer and WGL context. Execute only the in-memory command prefix. Publish the final scanout after digest and geometry validation.
caveats: One desktop trace. Excludes application-specific picture composition, live network failure timing, signed-in accounts and Windows 11 hardware.
